title: Create Community Interaction ads
content_data:
This article walks you through the steps to create Community Interaction ads. # Introduction With the Community Interaction objective, you can build and nurture your connections with one of the most valuable communities that exists today - the TikTok community. This objective allows you to drive follower growth or increase traffic to different landing pages on TikTok. **You can use Campaign Management API to create Community Interaction ads, and this helps you streamline your ad creation experience, and elevate operational efficiency and scalability.** # Prerequisites - You've gained access to TikTok API for Business. See [Get Started - Step by step workflow](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713609895937) for details. - To create Community Interaction ads, you need relevant permissions. See [API Reference](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1735713875563521) to find out permissions required for endpoints (including the endpoints listed in the "Steps" section) and see [Update app permissions](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738855280338946) to find out how to configure permissions. # Steps ## 1. Create a campaign Create a campaign using [/campaign/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739318962329602). Note that the following requirements must be met.
Setting Requirement Parameter How to configure the parameter
Advertising objective Community Interaction objective_type ENGAGEMENT
Smart+ Campaign Disabled

You cannot use /campaign/spc/create/ to create a Smart+ Community Interaction campaign.		 /
 /
iOS 14 Dedicated Campaign Disabled campaign_type REGULAR_CAMPAIGN or not passed
app_id Not passed
campaign_app_profile_page_state Not passed
### Example Request ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/campaign/create/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "objective_type": "ENGAGEMENT", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "budget": {{budget}} }' (/code) ``` Response ```xcodeblock (code curl http) { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "budget_mode": "BUDGET_MODE_TOTAL", "objective": "LANDING_PAGE", "budget": {{budget}}, "deep_bid_type": null, "is_smart_performance_campaign": false, "is_advanced_dedicated_campaign": false, "is_search_campaign": false, "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "campaign_type": "REGULAR_CAMPAIGN", "modify_time": "{{modify_time}}", "roas_bid": 0, "rta_id": null, "secondary_status": "CAMPAIGN_STATUS_ENABLE", "campaign_name": "{{campaign_name}}", "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "objective_type": "ENGAGEMENT", "operation_status": "ENABLE", "is_new_structure": true, "campaign_id": "{{campaign_id}}", "rta_product_selection_enabled": false } } (/code) ``` ## 2. Create an ad group Create an ad group using [/adgroup/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739499616346114). Note that the following requirements must be met. ```xtable | Setting{20%} | Requirement{25%} | Parameter{20%} | How to configure the parameter{35%} | |---|---|---| | Interaction type | TikTok account

Note: Creating Community Interaction ad groups with interaction type as Live is not supported via API. | / | /

Note: All Community Interaction ad groups created through the API use "TikTok account" as the default interaction type. | | Placements | Select Placement with only TikTok placement

Optionally, you can specify the following TikTik subplacements:

  • In-feed. Ads will be placed in the For You feed and might also be placed in Profile Page and Following feeds.
  • Search feed (supported with allowlist)
  • TikTok Lite (supported with allowlist), a streamlined version of TikTok that features a smaller app size and faster video loading speed. The TikTok Lite subplacement is currently available for Japan or South Korea as targeting locations.
| `placement_type`
`placements`
`tiktok_subplacements` | Set `placement_type` to `PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL`, and set `placements` to `["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]`

Optionally, you can specify the following TikTik subplacements via `tiktok_subplacements`:
  • `IN_FEED`
  • `SEARCH_FEED`
  • `TIKTOK_LITE`to-be-deprecated

Note:

  • Starting July 19th, 2025, you will no longer be able to create or copy ad groups using the TikTok Lite subplacement (`TIKTOK_LITE`). To ensure a smooth and uninterrupted ad creation experience, we recommend that you avoid creating new ad groups with this subplacement or copying campaigns that contain such ad groups.
  • Using the Search feed subplacement (`SEARCH_FEED`) in your ad group is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.
  • Using the TikTok Lite subplacement (`TIKTOK_LITE`) in your ad group is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.
  • If you pass `tiktok_subplacements`, you need to at least include `IN_FEED` in the `tiktok_subplacements` value.
  • To include `TIKTOK_LITE` in the `tiktok_subplacements` value, you need to include locations in Japan or South Korea in your targeted locations (`location_ids`). Otherwise, an error will occur.
  • If you include `SEARCH_FEED` or `TIKTOK_LITE` in the `tiktok_subplacements` value, you cannot set `brand_safety_type` to `THRID_PARTY`.
| | Optimization goal | Any of the following optimization goals:
  • Follow
  • TikTok page visits
| `optimization_goal` | Any of the following values:
  • `FOLLOWERS`
  • `PAGE_VISIT`
| | Bid Strategy | Any of the following types:
  • Maximum Delivery
  • Cost Cap
| `bid_type`
`bid_price`
`conversion_bid_price` | Any of the following values for `bid_type`:
  • `BID_TYPE_NO_BID`
  • `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`
    • If `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` and `optimization_goal` is `FOLLOWERS`, pass `conversion_bid_price` at the same time.
    • If `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM` and `optimization_goal` is `PAGE_VISIT`, pass `bid_price` at the same time.
| | Billing event |
  • If optimization goal is TikTok page visits, the billing event should be CPC.
  • If optimization goal is Follow, the billing event should be oCPM.
| `billing_event` |
  • If `optimization_goal` is `PAGE_VISIT`, set this field to `CPC`.
  • If `optimization_goal` is `FOLLOWERS`, set this field to `OCPM`.
| | Delivery Type |
  • If Bid Strategy is Maximum Delivery, you can only set Delivery Type to Standard.
  • If Bid Strategy is Cost Cap, you can set Delivery Type to Standard or Accelerated.
| `pacing` |
  • If `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_NO_BID`, you can only set `pacing` to `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH`.
  • If `bid_type` is `BID_TYPE_CUSTOM`, you can set `pacing` to `PACING_MODE_SMOOTH` or `PACING_MODE_FAST`.
| | Split test | Supported

Create an ad Create an ad using [/ad/create/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1739953377508354). Note that the following requirements must be met.
Setting Requirement Parameter How to configure the parameter
Smart Creative Disabled

You cannot pass is_smart_creative in /ad/aco/create/ to create Smart Creative Community Interaction ads.		 / /
Ad format Single Video ad_format SINGLE_VIDEO
Identity Any of the following options:
  • Authorized User
  • TikTok User
  • TikTok Account User in Business Center
 identity_type Any of the following values:
  • AUTH_CODE
  • TT_USER
  • BC_AUTH_TT

To learn about how to create Spark Ads, refer to Create Spark Ads.
identity_id Pass a valid value.

To get the list of identities under your ad account, use /identity/get/.
identity_authorized_bc_id Pass a valid value when identity_type is BC_AUTH_TT
Destination
  • If optimization goal is specified as Follow at the ad group level, the destination is the TikTok account profile page.
  • If optimization goal is specified as TikTok page visits at the ad group level, you can choose any of the following types:
    • Account profile
      • You don't need to provide a TikTok page URL or a TikTok Instant Page.
    • Other TikTok page
      • You need to provide a TikTok page URL.
    • TikTok Instant Page
      • You need to provide a Custom TikTok Instant Page.
tiktok_page_category
landing_page_url
page_id
  • If optimization_goal is set to FOLLOWERS at the ad group level, you don't need to pass tiktok_page_category, landing_page_url and page_id.
  • If optimization_goal is set to PAGE_VISIT at the ad group level, you need to pass tiktok_page_category to specify the exact destination:
    • If you want to set the Destination to Account profile, set tiktok_page_category to PROFILE_PAGE and don't pass landing_page_url and page_id.
    • If you want to set the Destination to Other TikTok page, set tiktok_page_category to OTHER_TIKTOK_PAGE and pass the TikTok page URL of a Playlist Page, Hashtag Page, Music Page, or Branded Effect Page via landing_page_url. Do not pass page_id.
      • To obtain a TikTok page URL, tap on the top right corner of the TikTok page you want to promote within your TikTok app, and click to copy the URL.
    • If you want to set the Destination to TikTok Instant Page, set tiktok_page_category to TIKTOK_INSTANT_PAGE and pass the ID of a TikTok Instant Page via page_id. Do not pass landing_page_url.
      • To obtain Custom TikTok Instant Pages within your ad account, use /page/get/ and set business_type to TIKTOK_INSTANT_PAGE.
Call-to-action
  • If optimization goal is specified as Follow at the ad group level: Disabled.
  • If optimization goal is specified as TikTok page visits at the ad group level: Specify a standard call-to-action or a dynamic call-to-action.
 call_to_action
call_to_action_id
  • If optimization_goal is set to FOLLOWERS at the ad group level, do not pass call_to_action and call_to_action_id.
  • If optimization_goal is set to PAGE_VISIT at the ad group level, specify a standard call-to-action via call_to_action or a dynamic call-to-action via call_to_action_id.
    • To learn about the supported values for call_to_action, see Enumeration - Call-to-action.
    • To learn about how to obtain a call_to_action_id, see Dynamic CTAs.
Interactive add-on (Optional) Disabled or enabled with the following type:
  • Reminder Countdown Sticker

Note: If you specify the TikTok subplacement Search feed at the ad group level, you cannot use Reminder Countdown Sticker.

 card_id Not passed or specify the ID of the following creative portfolio type:
  • Reminder Countdown Sticker (sticker_type as REMINDER_COUNTDOWN or LIVE_REMINDER_COUNTDOWN)

To create a creative portfolio, use /creative/portfolio/create/.
  • To learn about how to get the ID of a Countdown Sticker portfolio, see Stickers.

Note: If you include SEARCH_FEED in the tiktok_subplacements value at the ad group level, you cannot use Reminder Countdown Sticker via card_id at the ad level.
